disc flip - a process of imploding on a tube, punty to the back, remove the tube, punty to the front, and implode more.

punty - glass that is used to temporarily hold the working section.

rod - a solid straight section of glass.

sock flip - a process of imploding on a tube, blowing out the tube away from the work, imploding the work, allowing it to sag into the blown out section, connecting another tube to the outer slumped section, then removing the first tube.
